ownRead.statement:
## E06 — Resonant pattern formation in a chemical system

**experiment · partial bridge · claims C2, C3.**

**Reported result:** Periodic illumination of a photosensitive chemical oscillator locks responses to the forcing and changes the spatial pattern.

**Already supplied:** The reaction medium and periodic optical drive are supplied externally.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** The experiment links temporal forcing and spatial organization, not the spontaneous origin of the drive or new fundamental laws.

**Source:** Petrov, Ouyang & Swinney (1997), *Nature 388, 655–657*. [DOI: 10.1038/41732](https://doi.org/10.1038/41732).

**Verification coverage:** Publisher abstract and record. Checked 2026-10-02.
